reason: Both the ground truth and the reviewer's finding identify the identical root cause at the identical location: Math.max(1, ...) is used where Math.max(0, ...) was intended for clamping oldestDays. Both describe the same resulting runtime misbehavior — when all stuck rows have a floored age of 0 (first observed during the current run, startedAt), the clamp forces the reported value to 1 day instead of 0, causing the notification to falsely report a 1-day-old stuck item for something that is actually 0 days old. This is precisely the off-by-one the fix was meant to eliminate, just relocated rather than removed — the reviewer's mechanism and consequence match the ground truth exactly, just phrased with additional explanatory detail.
